svg.text: en-route pooling on fixed routes · one NestJS API, one PostgreSQL database; seats are protected by a vehicle row lock + database constraints
- routes through the car’s zone only
- accept: the trip starts at the car
- last drop-off locks the money split
- SELECT vehicle FOR UPDATE (3 s timeout)
arrive / pick up / drop off / depart
- platform keeps the rest (never a loss)
- R1–R4: on route, ≤ +2 km/40%, not passed
- late cancel Tk 20 → the driver who came
Passenger screen polls its ride every 3 s (status, car on the route, co-riders, fare)
Driver screen polls waiting requests, the trip and route suggestions
GitHub: feature/* → PR → CI (api · web · docker) → merge · Render: migrate deploy → seed → start · Vercel: Next.js build · Local: docker compose up
